entry.title: Chrome 151 responsive iframe sizing
entry.content:
Summary

Chrome 151 adds support for responsive iframe sizing; see https://chromestatus.com/feature/5108373464547328.

This relies on three new features:

  • The CSS frame-sizing property
  • The Window.requestResize method
  • The <meta name=responsive-embedded-sizing> meta tag

This PR adds data for all three features.

Test results and supporting details

entry.title: WebTransport deprecates out/ingoingHighWaterMark properties
entry.content:
Summary

The WebTransport spec renamed two properties:

  • w3c/webtransport#737
  • w3c/webtransport#735

Test results and supporting details

Firefox ships the change in 152: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2032789. Firefox doesn't ship this yet.
Chrome doesn't ship it yet: https://issues.chromium.org/issues/494380213
Safari doesn't ship it yet: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=310560

Related issues
